cost_usd_at_anthropic_first_party_rates.note: Bedrock Converse returns NO cost field and pricing:GetProducts is IAM-denied to this role, so this is DERIVED from Anthropic first-party Haiku 4.5 rates ($1/$5 per Mtok), NOT a verified Bedrock price. Registry entries stay unpriced for this reason.

image_bytes.note: rows_over_ceiling equals the api_error count exactly — the 5 MB cap is enforced on the BASE64 payload, so the raw-PNG ceiling is ~3.75 MiB.
